products.title: Grade B Refurbished Purple Enterprise 200 | Bariatric Folding Electric Wheelchair
products.body_html:
Heavy-Duty Comfort and Brushless Performance

Discover the Grade B Refurbished Enterprise 200 in Purple, a bariatric folding electric wheelchair designed for users who need higher weight capacity without moving to a large, bulky traditional powerchair.

The Enterprise 200 supports users up to 200 kg and features a generous 53 cm wide seat, combining additional space and stability with a foldable aluminium frame designed for easier transport and storage.

Powered by premium 350W sine-wave brushless motors, the Enterprise 200 delivers smooth acceleration, responsive control and strong performance across everyday outdoor surfaces. Its advanced front-axle suspension helps absorb shocks and vibrations, while large 12.5-inch rear tyres provide additional traction and stability.

The front-access twin battery system makes charging and battery removal more convenient. A standard 24V 12Ah airline-friendly lithium battery is available, with a second battery slot allowing users to extend their range when required.

Comfort and practicality are further supported by a telescopic footplate, removable anti-tip wheels, LCD joystick controller, handheld remote and flexible joystick positioning on either the left or right armrest.

Grade B Condition: This individual Purple Enterprise 200 shows more noticeable cosmetic wear than a Grade A model, with scratches to the footplate and scuffs to the main frame. These marks are cosmetic only and do not affect the chair's intended operation or performance. Please review the product images carefully for the exact condition of this individual chair.

products.title: Grade A Refurbished Champagne Freedom Elite AF | Automatic Folding Brushless Electric Wheelchair
products.body_html:
Premium Automatic Folding Mobility

Discover the Grade A Refurbished Freedom Elite AF in Champagne, a premium automatic folding electric wheelchair designed for users looking for a combination of effortless portability, comfort and smooth brushless performance.

The Freedom Elite AF features remote-controlled automatic folding, allowing the chair to fold and unfold at the touch of a button. This makes storage and transport considerably easier, particularly for users who may find manually folding a powerchair difficult. Its folded dimensions are approximately 44 × 62 × 76 cm.

Powered by dual 300W brushless motors, delivering 600W of combined power, the Freedom Elite AF provides quiet, responsive and efficient performance. Its reinforced aluminium frame supports users up to 160 kg, while solid tyres and anti-tip wheels provide additional practicality and stability for everyday use.

The twin battery slot system allows users to tailor the chair to their needs. The standard 24V 12Ah lithium battery is airline-friendly, while larger 20Ah battery options are available for users prioritising additional range. Batteries can also be removed for convenient off-board charging.

A wide seat option is available, with the distance between the armrests configurable up to approximately 52 cm. The joystick can also be positioned on either the left or right side, allowing the chair to be better configured around the user.

Grade A Condition: This individual Champagne Freedom Elite AF is in very good overall condition with only minor cosmetic scratches to the anti-tip wheel bar. These marks are cosmetic only and do not affect the chair's intended operation or performance. Please review the product images carefully for its exact condition.

products.title: Grade A Refurbished Silver LiteMax 2 | Ultra-Lightweight Folding Electric Wheelchair
products.body_html:
Ultra-Lightweight Mobility for Everyday Independence

Discover the Grade A Refurbished LiteMax 2 in Silver, an ultra-lightweight folding electric wheelchair built for users who prioritise portability, convenient transport and everyday independence.

With a minimum lifting weight of just 20 kg and a compact 58 cm overall width, the LiteMax 2 is one of Etech Mobility's lightest folding electric wheelchairs, making it easier to lift into suitable car boots, store at home and take on everyday journeys. Despite its lightweight construction, it supports users up to 120 kg.

Large 12.5-inch rear wheels help provide improved stability, while the extended footplate and lift-up armrests add comfort and practicality. The chair is designed for indoor use and light outdoor terrain such as pavements, shopping areas and other smoother surfaces.

The standard 12Ah lithium battery is airline-friendly, making the LiteMax 2 particularly suited to travel, while an optional 20Ah battery provides additional range for longer journeys. The battery uses a removable slide-in design for convenient off-board charging. A handheld remote control is also included, allowing a carer to assist with steering and manoeuvring when required.

The joystick can be positioned on either the left or right armrest. If a left-hand joystick is required, this can be requested when ordering.

Grade A Condition: This individual Silver LiteMax 2 is in very good overall condition with only minor cosmetic scratches to the footplate and wheel axles. These marks are cosmetic only and do not affect the chair's intended operation or performance. Please review the product images carefully for the exact condition of this individual chair.

products.title: Grade A Refurbished Red Freedom Pro ST | Lightweight Folding Electric Wheelchair
products.body_html:
Powerful, Portable Everyday Mobility

Discover the Grade A Refurbished Freedom Pro ST in Red, a lightweight folding electric wheelchair designed to combine powerful performance, comfortable everyday mobility and convenient portability.

Powered by dual 350W motors, delivering 700W of combined power, the Freedom Pro ST provides confident performance across pavements, gravel, short grass, hard sand and other suitable everyday surfaces. Its folding aluminium frame makes it practical for transport and storage, while supporting users up to 160 kg. The current listing also offers multiple 12Ah and 20Ah battery configurations.

The Freedom Pro ST features front and rear suspension, puncture-proof tyres, flip-up armrests and a telescopic footplate for improved comfort and practicality. Its twin battery slot system also allows batteries to be removed conveniently for charging while the chair remains folded or stored.

A wide seat option is available on request, providing additional seating space where required. Customers should contact the team before ordering so availability and suitability can be confirmed.

Grade A Condition: This individual Red Freedom Pro ST is in very good overall condition with light cosmetic scratches to the main frame, footplate and joystick. These marks are cosmetic only and do not affect the chair's intended operation or performance. Please review the product images carefully for its exact condition.
